U64.$comment: The single owner of the decimal-string u64 scalar (📋️cross-partition-requests.md row 151). A u64 exceeds IEEE-754 double precision, so every JSON carrier on the wire spells it as a canonical decimal string: no sign, no leading zero, no separator, 0 ≤ value ≤ 18446744073709551615. Every other scope references this export instead of restating the pattern (📋️execution-contract.md §A).

NonZeroU64.$comment: U64 minus the single value "0": the identity-and-generation narrowing the 🎭️actor family speaks, where 0 is the reserved never-allocated sentinel and is rejected on the wire (🚪️lifetime/🧪️tests/…/🟦️.ts asserts "0" invalid beside "-1", "01" and 2⁶⁴). Expressed as a narrowing of U64, never as a second pattern (📋️execution-contract.md §A).
